# Owl.co

Owl.co is a fintech AI company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It is listed in the portfolio of Luge Capital.

AI claims intelligence for insurance carriers that reads full claim files, detects fraud and answers examiner questions with citations.

[owl.co](https://owl.co/)
